jobs.occupation: Founding Sales Lead (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description: RoleHive Robotics builds RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms: connecting, controlling and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our systems are made in Germany, in serial production and deployed on active frontlines.You’ll be our first sales hire. There is no sales team, no SDRs and no playbook to inherit. This is a hands-on role: you find the leads, make the calls, write the offers and negotiate the contracts yourself. You work directly with our founders, report to the CEO, and get a lot of trust and room to decide how you sell. We measure you on signed contracts.Some leads come from our founders and Business Development. Many you’ll find yourself, through cold calls, cold emails, events and your own network. You take over a live pipeline and our existing customers, so we expect your first closes within three months.You don’t need a defence background or an engineering degree. Our engineers and Field Application Engineers know the product in depth, and you can bring them in whenever a deal needs it. What we need from you is the ability to run large, complex deals to signature on your own.Responsibilities- Close deals. Take opportunities from the first conversation to a signed contract, negotiate price and terms yourself, and bring in the founders when a deal needs them.- Build your own pipeline. Leads from the founders and BD give you a start. The rest comes from your own outreach: cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, trade fairs and introductions you find yourself.- Grow our existing customers through follow-on orders, new units and new use cases.- Write the offer: configuration and pricing, terms, the business case on the customer’s own numbers and the plan to signature. Handle tenders and RFPs where they apply.- Use trials to win contracts. Before a trial starts, scope, success criteria, pilot price and the path to the main contract are agreed in writing. Operations handles the paperwork.- Keep a forecast the founders can plan with: disciplined qualification, an up-to-date CRM and a short weekly pipeline review.- Set up the tools you work with every day, from offer templates to your CRM.RequirementsWhat you bring- 5 to 10 years in B2B sales, ideally around 7, with a clear record of closing- Deals of €2m to €10m and more that you personally negotiated and closed- Experience with buyers who decide in groups: users, technical teams, procurement, legal and management- You do the work yourself. You research accounts, pick up the phone and write your own offers, without a team preparing things for you.- Closing is what drives you. You chase the next step, follow up until you get an answer and don’t let deals stall.- You write down offers, decisions and customer commitments, so Operations and the founders can act on them without asking- Willingness to travel 30-50%, mostly within Germany and Europe, sometimes further- Fluent English; German is a strong plus- Eligibility and willingness to undergo security vetting, which some customer sites requireNice to have- Experience selling hardware or other physical products with lead times and delivery commitments- Experience with defence, public-sector or other long, regulated buying processes- You’ve worked as the first or only salesperson in a company beforeFurther InformationYou start with a solid base salary that gives you a stable foundation. On top of that comes a strong variable component tied directly to the deals you close: the more you close, the more you earn, and strong performers earn well above their base. You also participate in Hive through our VSOP, so you share in the value you help build.Über unsWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- **Compensation. **We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: MarketingZwingend erforderlich: Vertrieb

B2) and at least basic German language skills.• Availability for onboarding in February 2027, including the 6-month training in Tainan, Taiwan.Nice to Have:• Prior experience in cleanroom environments, semiconductor manufacturing, or precision industries (e.g., optics, electronics, medical technology).• Basic understanding of defect inspection systems, statistical process control, or 6S principles.• Mandarin language skills (beneficial for cross-site collaboration).Reasons to join ESMC• Security & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs.• Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).• Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden.• Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you continuously expand your knowledge.• Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit.• Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket).Application documentsPlease apply with your English CV.About usEach journey starts with a first step.Joining ESMC at this early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your true potential to the test. You will be working in a fast paced, international startup environment whilst at the same time having access to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both in Taiwan and other sites around the world.Behind the world’s most advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust (ICIC).We create a work environment that promotes diversity, ignites passion and enables you to reach your full potential.At ESMC, we welcome applications from all people, regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age or sexual identity.

jobs.occupation: Treasury Corporate Finance Senior Manager (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Bank und Finanzdienstleistungen)
jobs.description: Job RequirementsDo you want to help create the future of healthcare? Our name, Siemens Healthineers, was selected to honor our people who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause. It reflects their pioneering spirit combined with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry.We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone in order to grow personally and professionally. Sounds interesting?Then come and join our global team as Treasury Corporate Finance Senior Manager (f/m/d) and play a key role in shaping our financing strategy, optimizing our capital structure, and driving financing and capital market transactions.This position is full-time or part-time with a minimum of 32h/week.Choose the best place for your work - Within the scope of this position, it is possible, in consultation with your manager, to work mobile (within Germany) up to an average volume of 60% of the respective working hours.Even more flexibility? Mobile working from abroad is possible for up to 30 days a year under certain conditions and in selected countries.For hiring within Germany: Please note that this position is based exclusively in Erlangen, regardless of any other locations listed in this job posting.Your tasks and responsibilities:* You manage and optimize the Company's capital and funding structure and develop the related financing strategy.* You structure, execute, and negotiate financing and equity transactions, including bilateral and syndicated bank financing, bond issuances, maintenance of EMTN and Commercial Paper program documentation, share buybacks, and other capital market activities.* You act as a contact for rating agencies, global banking partners, and fixed-income investors.* You support financial due diligence activities as part of M&A transactions and other strategic projects.* You contribute your expertise to cross-functional initiatives and support data-driven decision-making across Treasury and Finance functions.To find out more about the specific business, have a look at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/products-servicesYour qualifications and experience:* You hold a university degree in Corporate Finance, Capital Markets, Banking, Law, or a related discipline.* You have several years of professional experience in Corporate Treasury, Capital Markets, Financing, and Financial Strategy, preferably within an international corporation or financial institution, and proven experience in preparing, reviewing, and negotiating financing agreements and capital market documentation.* You bring strong financial modelling, financial engineering, and financial analysis capabilities and are familiar with market information providers such as Bloomberg and Refinitiv/Reuters.* You have a good general understanding of related functional areas such as taxation, accounting (IFRS), legal and compliance, and investor communication. Knowledge of capital markets regulations, securities law, or related regulatory frameworks is an advantage.Your attributes and skills:* You enjoy analyzing complex questions and challenges in a structured and fact-based manner and you can inspire others to do the same.* You are proactive in bringing forward ideas, influencing stakeholders, and driving initiatives to successful implementation.* You communicate effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels, including senior management.* You combine deep finance expertise with business acumen and a collaborative mindset.* You thrive in a teamoriented international environment and enjoy working across functions and cultures.* You are fluent in English; German language skills are beneficial. Additional languages are welcome.* You leverage innovative approaches and emerging technologies to create value and drive improvements in Treasury and Corporate Finance.Our global team:Siemens Healthineers is a leading global medical technology company. 74,000 dedicated colleagues in over 70 countries are driven to shape the future of healthcare. An estimated 5 million patients across the globe benefit every day from our innovative technologies and services in the areas of diagnostic and therapeutic imaging, laboratory diagnostics and molecular medicine, as well as digital health and enterprise services.Our culture:Our culture embraces different perspectives, open debate, and the will to challenge convention. Change is a constant aspect of our work. We aspire to lead the change in our industry rather than just react to it. That's why we invite you to take on new challenges, test your ideas, and celebrate success.Check our Careers Site at https://careers.siemens-healthineers.com/global/enAs an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.Wish to find out more before applying? Contact us: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com, if you wish to discuss any initial questions with our recruitment team. The contact person handling this job ad is Petra Hübener.We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile in our talent community where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Visit https://careers.siemens-healthineers.com/global/en to get started.To all recruitment agencies:Siemens Healthineers' recruitment is internally managed, with external support permitted only when a qualified supplier has established a formal contract with us. Unsolicited candidate submissions and referrals, absent a current supplier contract, do not establish consent and are ineligible for fees. We delete and destroy unsolicited information, thus, would recommend you refrain from any such practices. Your adherence to our policies is appreciated.
